content: Nswɛɛŋ ifà ifà
Làläb mukwen bɛ a bɛ.
Twon lan'diimà muwal baar ubwaŋ. Ntɔn ya, bàmbɔɔn bàwɛl akyeey ukɔɔn ayöb.
Làyɔbà baar abà u bɔlokà, asànaa bɛ làbà u bɔlokà sye anà ba. Làyɔbà baar abà unsà mpay, ntɔn bɛ sye làbye anà ndür asànaa ba.
Wɛy bɔr làkäl làlàkoo akà baar banswà anà mbiin ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akal udu a itäb, ntɔn Nzam asàtsul mbar a baar a inswem anà bà ipasàsɛ.
Wɛy ukwen a ngim bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n abilà u nkääl abɛ, làkyey undiir làwà bɛ awa, ntɔn Nzam ŋakwo kàtɛn naa: « Mɛ insawɛy anki, mɛ in'sakɔɔb anki akà àkikye! »
Kyakin, bi itɛn unsà kam lanswà naa:

content.text: mɛ bɔɔmà undiir mwɛy in'sàman anki.

content: Làyɔbà baar bàlayaalà, bàlakyäänà ndaa a Nzam. Làyɔbà naa mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba kàkäl aben anà nkweel aba yàkäl aben, anà làyweel làkwikilà aba.
Yɛsu Klistɔ wà ifà imwɛy, yweenà, ŋàbà, anà mbul a in'tye.

Twon lan'pà mbwo naa an'lɔɔŋ ingyey mà ifà ifà màlabwiy ndwaŋ. Ntɔn yà ubwaŋ naa mpem ikäl ngwal u mbwo a kab a ngway, wɛɛ kà u mbwo a isaa mpa byàpɛ akà bweel mwɛy akà baar bàfàsyääl ya asànaa un'kɔɔn.
Bi ibye anà mɛsà a ibɔɔn, wɛɛ angaŋ bàfàsal uboo a idwà ikɔ̈b adyà isaa bàpɛ an'kab kyatɛy.
Ntɔn in'twaŋ a ntsür, ayà ufàsyen undweer a angaŋ an'kil amya uboo a idwà ntɔn ndwääl a man'be, mya bàfàfub u nsà a bul.
Kyakin Yɛsu sye kàkü u nsà a bul, ntɔn mubuul baar bàŋin'kyɛɛl u mbwo a an'kil ande ŋakwo.
Abun, bi ikyà u nsà a bul mukàbwey anà nde, anà mukyey musɛn un'tɛr a nswɛn kàmɛn nde.
Ntɔn u mɛɛn pà bi ibye anki anà bul ipepey, wɛɛ bi ibàmuleŋ bul làyàyà.
U mbwo a Yɛsu, wɛy bi ipɛ akà Nzam, ukɔɔn ayɔn, nsyäŋà abi asànaa ibɔɔn, iswaŋà naa an'kab a ndaa ifàtoo u mun a baar bàfàsyäŋà ikɔb ande.
Twon lan'diimà mukyer ndaa aŋàbwaŋ anà mutà ibay, ntɔn ibɔɔn a tub abi byàfàpà Nzam un'sak.

Làkäl anà unkyeey akà antwasà abɛ, lapɛ làzir, ntɔn ba bàfàler mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ, ntɔn ba bàsàtal un'lɔn awa akà Nzam. Abun, ba ban'kwo musal anà un'sak, kà unsà uŋün anki, undiir mpa uyàkal u bweel abɛ.
Làyamà ntɔn bi, ntɔn bi ibye anà kam mukal anà an'kyän aŋàpɔŋà anà bi ikwen mukal anà nkääl aŋàbwaŋ unsà indiir byanswà.
Mɛ amalàlɔm, làkyer ya apanà, ntɔn Nzam ukyer naa mɛ in'yàfurà agyägyä akà bɛ.
Ngyamàkà
Wɛy naa Nzam, awà ntwà a duu anà kàwiiy uboo a akü Mwol abi Yɛsu, awà kàbulà undweer a aseey a in'kɔk, u mbwo a an'kil a nkwà mwɛy yà mbul a in'tye,
wɛy nde kàlabuul bàŋàkwo mukyer yanswà yàŋàbwaŋ ntɔn mukyer ukwen ande, wɛy nde ukyer amu bi undiir ufàkyey nde, u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ, akà nde làkoo làkäl mbul a in'tye. Wöwöö!
Mbɔr a ntsüü
Atɔŋ, mɛ amàlalɔm, làwem unsà nkääŋ a mpem ndaa a mpɛɛl a ngwal yi! Ntɔn mɛ amàlasöön ikökö.
Làyöb naa un'tɔŋ abi Tumàtɛ bàkyun'tsuuŋ. Isàkal naa nde kan'yà làgyägyä, mɛ in'yàlaler anà nde.
Lapɛ antwasà abɛ mbɔr anà aŋin'kyɛɛl banswà. Baar abà kà Itali bàmàlapà mbɔr.
Wɛy kab a ngway a Nzam làkäl anà bɛ banswà!
